_comment: Single source of the firmware variants for CI (build matrix, YAML lint, generated files). name = OTA manifest name (manifest-<name>.json) and must equal the variant's firmware_variant substitution. pr = also compiled on pull requests (ventosync-full = required check, ventosync-v2-sgp41 = PCB v2.0 board package + SGP41/SHT45 drivers); all others are compiled after the merge. generate = file is created by `ci_config.py generate` (not in the repository). See .github/scripts/ci_config.py.
